title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Dynamic Handler Exception Close Policy Work Item
summary: Add exception-aware close policy selection for unexpected accepted WebSocket handler exceptions.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketClosePolicy` as the close status and reason value selected by HTTP/3 server policy.
- Add `Http3ServerOptions.WebSocketHandlerExceptionClosePolicySelector`.
- Resolve selector output in the existing accepted-tunnel handler-exception catch path with validation and static-policy fallback.
- Add a loopback server test that maps a thrown handler exception to a distinct close status and reason.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket dynamic close-policy test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: TCP proxy policy, backpressure, or stress coverage.
Automatic retry semantics based on close status.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Accepted WebSocket tunnel handler failures can now select close status and reason dynamically from the thrown exception while retaining the static fallback policy.
